messages:
Lena Ortiz: Help I accidentally selected a business-class upgrade for my return on the corporate booking and it charged my personal card. Can I expense it?
people-ops-bot: Quick policy note -> Upgrades are reimbursable only with manager pre-approval or when company-caused change requires a higher class. Personal-initiated upgrades are generally personal expense. See: https://intranet/redwood/te/upgrades (auto-note)
Marcus Green: If you asked travel to rebook because of a schedule change and they only had business available, that is usually covered. Do you have the change email or the TMC note?
Lena Ortiz: I rebooked myself on the airline site because my return time became unusable. Airline offered a $350 upgrade; I paid to keep my tight connection. I did not ping my manager first.
Priya Desai: Practical steps: 
- Upload the upgrade receipt and the original itinerary showing the conflict.
- Add a short rationale in Concur: "Missed connection risk + no available coach seats for same-day options."
- If manager retroactively approves, we can process reimbursement on a case-by-case basis, but finance may offset with alternate coach ticket cost.
travel-tmc-bot: If you rebook outside the TMC, we usually ask for proof there was no reasonable coach alternative. If you need corporate rebooking in future, DM @travel-tmc with PNR and we'll handle it (no extra charge for rebookings caused by schedule changes).
Marcus Green: Also note corporate card holders: corporate card policy only covers base fare and pre-approved ancillary items. Seat upgrades, lounge access, and extra legroom are personal unless pre-authorized or medically required (with documentation).
Lena Ortiz: OK I'm going to ask my manager for retro approval and attach flight screenshots. If manager says no, I accept it's personal. Anything else I should attach?
Priya Desai: Include screenshots of available coach seats (if any), the airline's change notification, and a short timeline (when you were notified, when you paid). That speeds review. If airline later refunds the upgrade, notify travel@redwood.com and we will adjust the claim.
Lena Ortiz: Thanks, filing now. Will ping manager and CC travel.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: For planned upgrades for health reasons, submit a medical note and manager sign-off before booking.
